text: Could provide, of course, cellular connectivity over an area. Think of a music concert with many, many people. Of course, there are cellular base stations there, but one could also allow this direct cellular communications between users. This is possible according to the standard. And why is that useful? Because when there is this kind of event, there are so many users that it is not possible or convenient to serve them through all base stations. And we need too much resources, radio resources, too many radio resources to provide services to all these users. So what what can do is, for example, in the case also of network operators, cellular network operators, is to use a mix of the infrastructure base and device to device communication to disseminate the data. For example, if we are in that scenario where there is a music concert with many people there. Consider that we have a base station and of course many many users, right? So let's assume that every user is requesting.
